description: US interstate movers and their household-goods complaint history from FMCSA's Protect Your Move search. By USDOT or MC number: name, numbers, address, phone, fleet, safety rating, authority types and complaints per year for the last four years by category (estimates, hostage goods, loss/damage, insurance...). By name or state: matching registered movers with location, fleet size and USDOT id. Takes about 21 s; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: gov_fmcsa_carrier_safety when you need FMCSA carrier census record by USDOT number from the public. Price: $0.004 per successful call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base, Solana and 10 more networks); failed calls are not charged.

dot.description: USDOT number for the full record with complaints

mc.description: MC docket number for the full record with complaints
